scope: Canonical test credentials and lossless identity-email upgrade only; not complete-app acceptance

migration.selection: Both stable IDs and the exact normalized previous email must match. Do not change a user's independently edited email.
preserved: password credentials including prior user resets
migration.auth_context: Update only this account's entry email and password-reset email. Pending registration, reset or active-session ownership prevents changing another account's context.
migration.persistence: Reuse existing clone-based additive hydration with zero storage/media writes and no extra startup wait. The next ordinary successful Store action atomically persists the renamed email with that action. A failed write leaves disk and attempted business changes untouched; the same upgrade is repeatable after restart.
migration.conflict: A destination email owned by another account fails closed before mutation; never merge, replace or delete either account.
migration.login: The old address is not an alias. The new address resumes the same identity. The bundled password is unchanged; a password previously changed by the user remains unchanged.
migration.first_install: No automatic test-account login. Code 009789 remains internal, exact-string validation only; no mail delivery or real student-verification claim is added.

untouched: website contact addresses and website files
historical evidence and saved fixture archives

coverage: old address and wrong password rejection
verification.warnings: No convention or browser warnings. Existing Xcode AppIntents metadata-skipped warning and simulator WebKit/Accessibility/process-suspension diagnostics remain in native logs.
verification.limits: Browser and isolated WKWebView cases use diagnostic fixture storage and a targeted failing write adapter, while retaining actual production Store actions, credential checks, Loading UI and static H5. Actual host storage is read-only during regression. No production test hooks, preview server, permission request or service-success claim added.
